```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
### 3D Subplot

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

# custom grid style
axx <- go_scene_axis(
  gridcolor = "rgb(255, 255, 255)",
  zerolinecolor = "rgb(255, 255, 255)",
  showbackground = TRUE,
  backgroundcolor = "rgb(230, 230,230)"
)

scene_row <- list(list(type = "scene"), list(type = "scene"))

fig <- make_subplots(rows = 2, cols = 2, specs = list(scene_row, scene_row))
for (row in 1:2) {
  for (col in 1:2) {
    fig <- fig |>
      add_surface(z = volcano, showscale = FALSE, row = row, col = col)
  }
}

fig <- fig |>
  update_scenes(xaxis = axx, yaxis = axx, zaxis = axx, aspectmode = "cube") |>
  update_layout(title = "3D Subplots")

fig
```

### Reference

See `go_scene()` and `go_scene_axis()` for more information and options!
